note: Corporate Contact & Reference Sheet — what each corporate role does, when to go to them, and how to reach them. Seeded ONCE (version-gated) onto matching employees by email; later edits made on the org chart are preserved. Bump `version` to re-apply an updated sheet (that will overwrite edits for the matched people). Bullet fields use one line per bullet.

roles.contactReasons:

roles.title: Director of HR & Administrative Affairs

Tracks and reports commission for the team

roles.name: Graham Foster
roles.title: Director of Field Operations
roles.roleResponsibilities:
Oversees branch operations and evaluates branch manager performance
Conducts weekly check-ins with Branch Managers to monitor progress
Supports technician performance, routing, and operational issue resolution
Conducts semi-annual audits of branches to ensure compliance and standards
Ensures safety protocols and approved product usage are followed
Reviews and improves operational processes and maintenance procedures
Handles escalated customer service issues requiring field operations input
Supports sales, marketing, and customer retention initiatives
Oversees technician training compliance and continued education
Monthly branch visits
Equips new vehicles and oversees vehicle deployment and operation
Final interview on most new hires
Acquires all uniforms for new hires
roles.contactReasons:
Escalated operational or technician performance issues
Questions about branch audits or safety compliance
Support needed for routing, technician scheduling, or operational processes
Coordination on sales, marketing, or retention efforts involving field operations
Technician training compliance and ongoing education inquiries
